tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: README defines the object catalog (black holes, wormholes, white holes), the data sources, and the layout of data/models/notebooks/premium. reports/summary.md then rolls up catalog counts (391 GWTC events), the implemented model inventory, and next steps.

tour.title: Core Physics Models
tour.description: models/equations.py provides the astropy-unit closed forms (Schwarzschild radius, Hawking temperature, Morris-Thorne metric); formulas.py extends with exact Kerr ISCO and Eddington limits; derivations.py derives everything symbolically in SymPy with explicit checks.

tour.title: Theory Library
tour.description: The premium theory set derives each spacetime family completely: theory_black_holes (Schwarzschild from first principles), Kerr-Newman and ADM masses, Reissner-Nordstrom, the 48 Christoffel symbols, geodesics with Carter constant, and the Raychaudhuri equation.

tour.title: Data Refresh Pipeline
tour.description: Scripts rebuild the observational snapshot: update_gwosc_gwtc5.py refreshes the full GWTC-1..GWTC-5 catalog (391 events), download_heasarc.py and download_blackcat.py pull REM/CV catalogs, and process_blackcat.py + add_bh_derived_quantities.py produce the processed CSVs.

tour.title: Compute & Verify With Data
tour.description: compute_with_data.py reconciles the catalog (chirp-mass and redshift recomputation, mass-gap candidates) and quicklooks marquee-event strain; verify_formulas.py executes every symbolic derivation and numeric spot check, writing reports/derivations_report.md.

tour.title: Dashboards & Figures
tour.description: Dashboard builders turn processed CSVs into reproducible Plotly HTML: GWTC remnants, AGN reverberation masses, and BlackCAT dynamical masses (limits kept as limits); create_animations.py and make_premium_figures.py add the visual layer.

tour.title: Notebook Suite
tour.description: The 24 notebooks carry the analysis narrative: fundamentals (01), extended models (02), derivations with SymPy (05), complete theory (10), then fast scientific-profile notebooks (14-19) and catalog notebooks (20-24) backed by the processed data.

tour.title: Frontier Topics
tour.description: The frontier modules: 23_early_smbh_growth.ipynb with its premium companion quantify the feasibility of early SMBH seeds under Eddington-limited growth with explicit selection caveats; 24_quantum_gravity.ipynb and its companion separate measured fact, derived algebra, and illustration.
